The chiton has a dark, textured body with eight overlapping calcareous plates visible on its dorsal surface. The plates show some coloration with hints of blue-green and brown. The surrounding environment includes rocky surfaces with some algae or marine growth. The chiton appears to be in its natural habitat, attached to the rock surface.
